unsupported: Now in its second generation of family ownership, Messenger Molding has spent nearly four decades building precision tooling and plastic injection molding for clients worldwide.

Messenger Molding operates as a full-service molder, offering in-house mold design and construction, plastic injection molding (including clean room capability), and secondary operations such as sonic welding, pad printing, assembly, drilling, tapping, and automation integration.
The company serves corporate clients across domestic and international markets, though specific industry sectors are not publicly detailed.
